'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Kevin Shannon DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Kind Of Scum|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
